thought.title: avg_pool2d Baseline Scalar Implementation
thought.description: Created AscendC kernel for avg_pool2d with k=2, s=2, p=0. Baseline uses scalar GetValue/SetValue for 2x2 window average. Block divides spatial output elements across 32 cores with 128 elements per block.
thought.reason: Baseline implementation provides correct reference for avg_pool2d with fixed k=2,s=2,p=0. Scalar implementation is straightforward but may benefit from vectorization.

runtime.dsl_before: Baseline scalar implementation with 2x2 window averaging
runtime.dsl_after: APKernel uses scalar GetValue/SetValue; block divides M spatial elements across 32 cores
